MODEL_BASE_URL.description: Gateway route: AI Gateway root for the Anthropic-compatible model endpoint, without /v1/messages.

MODEL_NAME.description: Gateway route: model name accepted by the gateway's model endpoint.

MCP_URL.description: Gateway URL of the Fusion Stock Watchlist MCP server.

AGENT_API_KEYS.description: Required. The key callers must send as x-api-key to the chat UI and the A2A agent (comma-separated for several). Generate one: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. If set, the agent calls Anthropic directly and bypasses the gateway. Leave unset to use the gateway.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.description: Optional. Anthropic model ID, used only with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
